app.title: BananaWiki
app.subtitle: Run a wiki on this computer for yourself or your class. Everything stays in the data folder below.
folder.title: Data folder
folder.choose: Choose the folder for the wiki's data
folder.use_subfolder:

server.title: Wiki
server.share: Let other devices on this network open the wiki (phones, tablets, pupils' computers)
share.confirm:
Anyone connected to the same network (Wi-Fi or cable) will be able to reach the wiki's sign-in page from their device. Only do this on a network you trust, such as your classroom's. Your computer may ask you to allow BananaWiki through the firewall.

Share the wiki on this network?

setup.explain: Open the wiki and create the administrator account. The setup page asks for this code:
data.title: Backups
data.restore_confirm:
Restoring replaces every page, account and file with the ones in the backup. The current data is kept in the "previous" folder inside the data folder.

Restore this backup?
data.restore_done: Backup restored. The replaced data is in {path}
data.reset_confirm:
This permanently deletes every page, account and uploaded file in this wiki. It cannot be undone; make a backup first if you may need them.

Delete all data?
data.reset_done: All data deleted. Start the wiki to set it up again.
status.running: The wiki is running on this computer only.
status.running_lan: The wiki is running and shared on the local network.
status.crashed: The wiki stopped unexpectedly. Look in the logs folder inside the data folder.
status.wait: Please wait until the current task has finished.
error.folder_invalid: This cannot be used as the data folder. Choose an ordinary folder.
error.folder_foreign: This folder belongs to another program. Choose a different folder.
error.folder_not_empty: This folder already contains other files. Choose an empty folder or a BananaWiki data folder.
error.folder_in_use: Another BananaWiki is already using this data folder. Stop it first.
error.unsafe_path: The data folder contains a link or special file where BananaWiki expects a normal folder or file.
error.secret_key_invalid: The wiki's key file (instance/.secret_key) is damaged. Restore it from a backup.
error.no_server_backend: This installation has no web server. Install waitress (pip install waitress).
error.no_free_port: No free network port was found. Close other servers and try again.
error.server_failed: The wiki could not start. Details are in the logs folder inside the data folder.
error.server_exited: The wiki stopped while starting. Details are in the logs folder inside the data folder.
error.server_timeout: The wiki did not answer in time. Details are in the logs folder inside the data folder.
error.archive_invalid: This file is not a ZIP backup.
error.archive_no_database: This backup does not contain a wiki database.
error.archive_foreign: This backup does not come from BananaWiki.
error.archive_too_new: This backup was made by a newer version of BananaWiki. Update this app first.
error.archive_unsafe: This backup contains an unsafe file name or file type and was not used.
error.archive_unexpected: This backup contains files that do not belong to a wiki and was not used.
error.unsafe_file: A file in the data folder is a link or special file and cannot be backed up.
error.backup_inside_folder: Save the backup outside the data folder.
error.backup_exists: A file with that name already exists. Choose a new name.
error.nothing_to_back_up: There is nothing to back up yet: start the wiki once first.
error.disk_full: There is not enough free disk space.
error.restore_journal_invalid: An interrupted restore left a damaged record (.restore.json). Check the data folder by hand.
